scope: 50 groups, 103 descriptions, 412 complete instrument variants; visually reviewed PDF300–304 and literal source columns/continuations
method: Sequential review of every rubric criterion and its success/partial formulation, with shared progression rules checked in the provider. Inspected complete checklist, achievement-scale and partial-credit circuit construction examples. Scoring and parity contracts supplement scientific review rather than replace it.
corrections: Measurements, designs and device construction have observable criteria without adding experiments
Interpretation of a provided circuit never requires construction
Graphs in feminine form are treated as data
Classification of mixtures does not duplicate its solution category
Light mixtures do not add material-mixture assessment
Comparisons include scientific relations; longitudinal/transverse waves and ionizing radiation are focused
Signals are not an instruction to identify or point
A supporting circuit does not force a second explanation
Energy conservation does not impose an efficiency proposal
Density, mean speed, acceleration and momentum specify the mathematical relation
limits: Defined deterministic descriptions, not arbitrary wording
Safety conditions are those explicitly indicated; no additional components, hazardous procedures or clinical interventions
The general research heading is a process menu, not another topic or a compulsory experiment
Full browser save/reopen checks are separate and recorded in the grade report
additionalScientificReview: Radar-only tasks explicitly use electromagnetic waves; mixed sonar/radar comparisons distinguish mechanical from electromagnetic propagation. The shared curricular heading does not mean the same physical mechanism. Regression failed before the correction and passed afterward.
